root.description: Root function (or import) and its VA.

direction.description: callers, callees or both (one level: each node's site is its call instruction).

parent.description: Parent node id; absent on the root.

address.description: VA of the function or import slot; absent when unresolved.

image.description: Image id when it differs from the root's.

edge.description: How the parent reaches it: call, jump (tail call), import, virtual, virtual?, dynamic, pinvoke, native (a managed method's native body), managed.

flags.description: repeated (expanded elsewhere), more (children not expanded), unresolved, not-loaded; caller or callee by call site.

note.description: Binding or edge detail: the provider of an import, the candidate count of a virtual call.

site.description: VA of the call instruction of the edge, when the tree is by call site.

frontier.description: VAs of nodes cut by depth or maxNodes: pass one as function to continue there.

engine.description: Analysis that produced the result: ours (built-in index), ida or ghidra.

engineNote.description: Why that engine answered: the engine parameter, the server default, or auto and the engine's analysis state.
